account._note: displayName/handle are placeholders — confirm availability before launch.

selection._versionTiersNote: The account exists to find songs worth hearing again as someone else's performance. A cover of another artist's song is the strongest form of that, and a different arrangement is weaker. A plain live rendition scored 0 until 2026-11-25, which kept it out of every automatic pick although posting live stages is the point of the account; it now scores 20, below the other two. v2.0 dropped the 'timeliness' item entirely: a hidden gem is usually an old video, and rewarding recency worked against the whole point.

rights._minDaysNote: A reel stays online after posting; a permission that ends the day after publish is treated as insufficient.

render._defaultClipNote: When the operator types only a start time, the end is filled in as start + this, capped at maxClipDurationSec. They can change it.
render._fontNote: null = auto-detect (Windows: Malgun Gothic Bold, Linux: Noto Sans CJK Bold, macOS: Apple SD Gothic Neo). Set an absolute path to override.
render._templatesNote: Templates live in templates/reels/<id>.json. The list rotates by operating date (days since epoch mod length).

analysis._loudnessNote: Fallback analyzer using the installed FFmpeg (astats RMS per second). Loudness only — it labels its result 'peak', never 'chorus'. Used when all-in-one is off and no cache or fixture exists.
analysis._note: all-in-one (mir-aidj/all-in-one) is optional. When disabled, cached results in cacheDir and — for TEST assets only — fixtures in fixtureDir are used, then the loudness fallback.

youtube._apiKeyNote: 검색(search.list)용 YouTube Data API v3 키. 여기에 적지 말고 config/local.json 또는 YOUTUBE_API_KEY 환경변수에 넣으세요 — 이 파일은 Git에 올라갑니다. 키가 없으면 앱 안 검색만 꺼지고, 나머지는 그대로 동작합니다.
youtube._quotaNote: 2026-11-25 확인: search.list 1회 = 100 units, 기본 할당량 10,000 units/일 → 하루 약 100회. 태평양 시간 자정 초기화. 페이지를 더 받으면 100 units가 또 듭니다(그래서 한 페이지만 받습니다). 초과 시 과금 없이 다음날까지 멈춥니다.
